# Iris v1

Iris v1 is a free local-first Windows AI assistant with typed chat, natural voice, camera and screen vision, local memory, web research, and approval-gated Hermes agent tools.

Canonical site: https://supermang617.github.io/IRIS/
Source repository: https://github.com/supermang617/IRIS
Current release: https://github.com/supermang617/IRIS/releases/tag/v1
Recommended download: https://github.com/supermang617/IRIS/releases/download/v1/iris-windows-installer.zip

## Key Pages

- Download and run: https://github.com/supermang617/IRIS/blob/main/docs/download-and-run.md
- Manual test guide: https://github.com/supermang617/IRIS/blob/main/docs/manual-test.md
- Runtime orchestration: https://github.com/supermang617/IRIS/blob/main/docs/runtime-orchestration.md
- Security policy: https://github.com/supermang617/IRIS/blob/main/SECURITY.md

## Summary

Iris is the user-facing desktop assistant. Hermes is the background agent path for approved research, memory transfer, browser work, and tool-backed tasks. Iris memory is local and Iris-owned; cloud-sync storage is not part of v1. Iris v1 is distributed from the single GitHub release tag v1.
